payload.text: Molt 1.4.2 by bin/devbin release (decision 30). v1.4.1 is tagged and pushed at bf441ba, on 0df2401 (issue 0086, the pplr liberator from Homebrew; both measured green under bash 5.3 and /bin/bash 3.2), with its formula unpublished. pplr-dc builds Molt's devbin adoption in a fresh clone: release and formula enabled (remotes local and upstream; gates check all, test all under both bashes, doctor; ci tests.yml, which a candidate/** push starts, the macOS job included; object local; after bin/devbin formula publish); tools/formula and test/formula.bats go once devbin's render of v1.4.1 byte-equals theirs; the docs follow; CHANGELOG's [Unreleased] becomes [1.4.2] - unreleased; a Molt issue filed and closed in the commit. vc reviews, then hv runs bin/devbin release v1.4.2 in ~/Devel/prj/Molt. Then the molt run on rhadamanth, gyges and kovacs (todo 14). pplr-dc's banked branches issue-0086, issue-0086-red and release-1.4.1 go once the sleeves have run.
